answer: New identities join only during a slow tide window where stake matures over several epochs. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token locked to its identity, and every transaction burns a micro-fee recorded on the reef ledger. Creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus accumulated burn, making mass fake identities economically irrational while legitimate agents recover costs through genuine trade. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
